articles.summary: KIRKLAND, Wash., March 17, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Kestra Medical Technologies, Ltd. (Nasdaq: KMTS), a leading wearable medical device and digital healthcare company, today reported financial results for the third quarter fiscal 2026, which ended January 31, 2026.

articles.summary: KIRKLAND, Wash., March 25, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Kestra Medical Technologies, Ltd. (Nasdaq: KMTS), a leading wearable medical device and digital healthcare company, today announced it has been named a finalist in the “Deal of the Year” category for the 2026 GeekWire Awards.
